title: Better PvP Visual
description: BPV makes your Gameplay better, perfect for all types of PvP or Vanilla players, it reduces view wastes like totem pop and shield blocking
body:
# **What Better PvP Visual do:**
This Resource Pack makes your Gameplay **better**, perfect for all PvP Players (**CPVP, Mace & Vanilla**), it **reduces view wastes like totem pops**, shield and fire but it adds a lot of useful things to _enhance_ your gameplay experience.

**In short: it basically makes your game cleaner and reduces visual chaos.** _**(Watch under)**_

![Head over to the gallery to see all the great features of this Resource Pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1587b175c5a3caaadd4527e183bf11435d68a4a0.png)
### Here is a summary of the features of this resource pack:
1. It reduces the size of a lot of items (Totem, Shield, Golden apple)

2. It makes game GUIs black (Like night settings)
 
3. It makes a lot of cool animations (Fire Rocket, Blaze Rod, Ender Pearls...)
 
4. It reduces the visual space waste (from: shield, totem size/pop/particles, pumpking blur)

5. It adds an exlamation mark to the powder snow to allert you from fall into it.
 
6. It removes the crystal explosion smoke and also the campfire and fire smoke

7. It changes the texture of crystals, redstone, tools and other things to save visual space
 
8. It changes the font of minecraft to make it simpler and cleaner
 
9. It adds some 3D models to Mace and also to the End Crystals

### **In short: it basically makes your game cleaner and reduces visual chaos.**
